capability_status: catalog advertises image input; this probe independently verified image access and decoding in this seat
probe_method: Images read directly from inputs/ via the read tool and decoded inline as raster images for the vision-capable configured model; descriptions below come from actual pixels, not filenames or manifest labels.

files.colors: White/very light gray background; solid saturated red square; solid saturated blue circle; near-black text.
files.shapes: A solid red rectangle (left of center, roughly square) and a solid blue circle (right of center).
files.text: Black sans-serif text reading 'PV 731', centered in the lower half.
files.location: Red rectangle occupies upper-left quadrant area; blue circle upper-right; caption lower-center.
files.typographic_anatomy: Single-line Latin sans-serif label, moderate size, no outline, no decoration.
files.interpretation: Routing control: a synthetic shape/label composition, not a PV frame. Correctly excluded from text-form counts.

files.colors: Dominated by warm sunset orange/red sky with clouds; dark red/black ground; chain-link fence renders as orange grid; character in pale pink/white school uniform with orange/pink hair and pink bows/clips; large glyphs near-black.
files.shapes: Anime girl centered (full body, front-facing, one hand raised near face); chain-link fence band across mid-frame; city skyline silhouette at lower right; cloud masses upper left/right.
files.text: Very large black Japanese glyphs '青電波' spanning nearly the full frame width across the mid band, rendered partially behind/in front of the character; smaller black text with thin underlines: '何度も' (upper left), '送られる' (upper right), '優しさだけで包んで' (lower left, overlapping the fence band).
files.location: Oversized glyphs horizontal center; three smaller underlined phrases in corners/lower-left; character centered overlapping the oversized glyphs.
files.typographic_anatomy: Oversized heavy mincho-style Japanese display glyphs with layered composition (glyphs interleave with character layer); smaller phrase text in mixed horizontal placement with hairline underlines; text-over-character and character-over-text overlap is directly visible in this single frame.
files.interpretation: Directly matches the oversized-glyph-over-character overlap relation cited in FORM-K72-004 and the shifting mixed-placement phrase layout of FORM-RBZ-001's family (though this source is warm polychrome, not pale monochrome). Single frame: traversal direction, easing, and beat sync remain unestablished.

files.colors: Soft pink/red field with subtle darker blotches; small white dots scattered sparsely; glyphs white with a thin darker outline/edge.
files.shapes: Sparse small white circles/dots (decorative particle field); no character visible in this frame.
files.text: Large white Japanese glyphs '綺' (upper center) and '羅' (lower center) with much smaller 'めいて' staggered between them, forming a vertical zigzag/staggered column at center.
files.location: Staggered vertical grouping, horizontally centered; particle dots scattered across the full field.
files.typographic_anatomy: Mixed-size Japanese glyphs in a staggered vertical arrangement: two oversized glyphs bracket a much smaller kana group; thin outline on white fills; strong size-contrast hierarchy within one phrase.
files.interpretation: Matches the 'resolve to a compact centered vertical grouping with sparse marks' end state of FORM-EXP04-TEXT-001, and the staggered vertical mixed-direction family (ARCH06-VERTICAL_AND_MIXED_DIRECTION_TYPOGRAPHY). The strong within-phrase size contrast (oversized bracketing glyphs + small kana) is also the signature of FORM-RBZ-001's 'oversized glyph emphasis'. Single frame: no motion, beats, or tile-collapse transition observable.

files.colors: Pale gray-blue background; lighter blue lower ground band; medium blue sans-serif letters; dark charcoal/gray door; light blue beam and speckled texture.
files.shapes: A dark gray/black open door standing vertically between the letters, with a light beam projecting from it onto the ground; horizontal divide between sky and ground; grainy blue speckle texture around the beam on the ground.
files.text: Large blue Latin sans-serif text: 'A' left of the door and 'SIGN' right of it, forming the interrupted wordmark 'A|SIGN' (reading as 'ASSIGN' with the door as the divider).
files.location: Wordmark centered horizontally at the sky/ground divide; door between the two text fragments; beam diagonal toward lower right.
files.typographic_anatomy: Large geometric sans-serif wordmark split by an integrated 3D/2.5D object (open door) standing in for a letter/divider; flat color fields; no outline, no gradients except the beam.
files.interpretation: Object-integrated wordmark: a physical prop (open door) interrupts and completes a title lockup, with environmental light interaction. Nearest existing candidates: FORM-EXP02-TEXT-010 (fragmented wordmark pieces resolving) and FORM-EXP02-TEXT-005 (staged wordmark reveal), but neither captures a standing object integrated into the mark with scene lighting. Single frame: entrance mechanism and hold timing unestablished.

uncertainties: Single frames cannot establish exact easing, beats, source lyrics (full lyric text), camera motion, or author intent.
Extraction labels (116.0s / 15.25s / 1.75s) do not themselves identify unique native PTS; static evidence only.
a.png glyph reading '青電波' is a best-effort reading of stylized overlapping glyphs; character/occlusion layering is visible but which layer is on top varies across the frame.
c.png wordmark reading 'A|SIGN' / 'ASSIGN' inferred from letter positions around the door; exact intended word not confirmed by motion.
Whether a.png's overlap implies continuous traversal or edited cuts is not decidable from one frame.
The control image confirms vision routing works; it is not a PV sample and contributes no form evidence.
visual_routing_conclusion: Vision input verified working in this seat. All three PV frames (a, b, c) are genuine PV evidence with source identities in the manifest. Visual descriptions recorded here support the text-form audit below; they do not constitute native-frame temporal acceptance.
